{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.06

|descr= Set maximum width of a control's tooltip.

|gr1= GUI Control

|s1= ctrl [[ctrlSetTooltipMaxWidth]] width

|p1= ctrl: [[Control]]

|p2= width: [[Number]] - in screen measurement units

|r1= [[Number]] - the previous maximum width of the tooltip

|x1= <sqf>private _previousMaxWidth = _myControl ctrlSetTooltipMaxWidth (SafeZoneW / 2);</sqf>

|seealso= [[SafeZone]] [[SafeZoneW]]
